selection: C1-C byte-preserving extraction of the eleven static visible-resume (record/liveness) reject hints of entwurf_resume_call; decoded text copied from the C0 pre-extraction inventory of sourceSha, never from the product JSON; acp-model-not-curated keeps its shared code-owned ACP_MODEL_NOT_CURATED_HINT, and the launch-stage mux hints stay code-owned behind the mux import fence

hints.target-invalid: no citizen has that id; discover targets with entwurf_peers
hints.target-backend-unsupported: that citizen's backend has no same-id resume (only pi and Claude Code do) — reach it with entwurf_v2, or open a fresh sibling
hints.target-locked: another resume or dispatch holds this citizen's lock right now
hints.target-live: that citizen is already running — this verb only reopens dormant ones
hints.target-indeterminate: the citizen could not be proven dormant (an inconclusive socket probe or receiver owner), so nothing was started
hints.target-receiver-absent: a Claude Code citizen is proven dormant only by its receiver marker, and it has none — if its window is closed, reopen it yourself
hints.target-receiver-corrupt: the citizen's receiver marker cannot be read as a marker, so its owner cannot be judged
hints.target-receiver-mismatch: the receiver marker under this garden id names another backend or native session than the record — look at the store before anything reopens
hints.target-receiver-unbound: the dead receiver owner is not bound to the record's last arm (none observed, a later attach, or the record moved), so a Claude Code process may still hold the session — if its window is closed, reopen it yourself
hints.target-address-conflict: that citizen's control-socket path is corrupt
hints.launch-refused: tmux was never asked to open a window
